ordinary_contract.platform: MSVC Win32, little-endian BYTE8, unsigned int32 and pointer32, ordinary flat data addressing; no portable ISO C++ physical identity claim
ordinary_contract.proposed_API: void* __cdecl bsp::copy_native_crt_padded_bytes_00bf9280(void* actual_destination, const void* actual_source, unsigned int count)
ordinary_contract.exception_specification: Default potentially throwing; no noexcept claim
ordinary_contract.zero_count: All unsigned32 count patterns admitted. Zero reads count home, saves EDI, branches, reads destination home and returns that genuine pointer. It never reads source home or either payload; any/null pointers are admitted.
ordinary_contract.positive_count: Destination provides the entire count-byte region of genuine live writable raw storage. Initial destination values need be determinate only where actually read through a source alias. Only actually reached source BYTE or complete DWORD windows must be genuine live readable determinate storage. No full unused source NUL extent is required; no NUL is required if copying exhausts count. A reached DWORD may include up to three later in-count bytes beyond the first NUL, all of which must be readable determinate bytes.
ordinary_contract.cursor_extent: All actual source/destination advances by 1 or 4 are nonwrapping32 and remain within or at one-past their same actual live allocation. Never dereference one-past. Include source advance before destination store and terminal advances; no signed-distance/INT_MAX cap or pointer subtraction.
ordinary_contract.aliases: Raw unaligned/interior/subrange/caller-stack storage and input/destination overlap are admitted when all reached accesses and advances satisfy the contract. Destination is writable; a distinct source may be read-only. No restrict or nonoverlap promise. Source bytes may change only through this call's own destination writes; later loads observe these self-induced changes. No immutable initial-source snapshot or memmove semantics is promised.
ordinary_contract.stability: No faults, asynchronous mutation, concurrency, MMIO, lifetime changes or unusual segment protocols. Exclude Original private callee frame, argument homes and saved-register self-alias; ordinary caller-stack storage remains admitted. Private native-home mutation and physical fault/flag/register/stack/segment identity are outside the new interface.
ordinary_contract.return: Return the genuine original destination pointer, including null for count0/null destination, with no ownership/access-permission transfer. Original reloads its destination argument home at all exits; a new saved genuine pointer is valid only under the home/private-frame alias exclusion.

ordered_schedule.description: Read count DWORD home before PUSH EDI/test; count0 branches directly to destination-home return. No source-home or payload read. Positive path then saves ESI/EBX; source home is read at9291 before destination home at929B. No argument-home writes.

While actual source is not4aligned: load exactly one unsigned BYTE; actual source+1; store the saved BYTE; actual destination+1; decrement remaining; return on count exhaustion before NUL test. A copied NUL with remaining>0 enters padding. Otherwise test new source alignment and repeat, or copy remaining to EBX and form word-count ECX=remaining>>2. At most3 peel bytes if neither earlier stop occurs.

For each complete4-byte residual block, read one DWORD into first word at9334; compute uint32 ((first+0x7efefeff)^~first)&0x81010100; unconditionally read exactly the same source DWORD again at933D, even when candidate mask is zero; actual source+4 before mask branch. No payload write occurs between the two reads, hence they agree in the ordinary domain. This is not candidate-only reread.

Mask0 stores the second word in one exact DWORD write, actual destination+4, decrements positive word count. Nonzero mask tests second-word lanes low-to-high in registers only. No lane NUL also stores second word (including rejecting high-byte0x80 false candidate). First NUL lane0 stores0; lane1 stores second&0xff; lane2 stores second&0xffff; lane3 stores second unchanged. Each is one DWORD store, possibly unaligned, with no BYTE reread or lane stores. NUL word then actual destination+4 and word-count-- before padding.

Initial aligned count1..3 or post-word residual remaining&3 uses exactly one BYTE read, source+1, saved BYTE store, destination+1. Test NUL before decrementing residual. Nonzero decrements/repeats; NUL decrements once at9318 and pads only positive remainder. All count-exhaustion and copied-NUL paths retain exact cursor/store order.

No more source reads or source advances. With AL0 and positive remaining, write BYTE0 and destination+1/count-- until destination4aligned or exhausted. Then save remaining in EBX and form word count remaining>>2. If wordcount0, EBX is1..3 and BYTE padding follows.

Write each remaining complete block as one DWORD0, destination+4, positive word-count--. After words, EBX&3 controls exact BYTE0 residual writes, each followed by destination+1 and decrement. Tail-copy NUL reaches the same BYTE padding loop after accounting for its copied NUL. No further source read. Full-word padding need not be destination aligned on the copied-DWORD-NUL path.

zero_detection.carry_derivation: For input bytes b0..b3 low-to-high, carry c1=(b0!=0), c2=(b1+254+c1>=256), c3=(b2+254+c2>=256). Candidate bits8,16,24 are respectively !c1,!c2,!c3. Any zero in b0..b2 therefore sets a candidate bit; a carry loss propagated through lower byte1 also remains a candidate.
zero_detection.high_lane: If all low3 bytes are nonzero then c3=1, and bit31 is set exactly when high byte is0 or0x80. If c3=0 a lower candidate already exists. Thus mask0 proves all4 lanes nonzero, and the only no-zero false candidate has high byte0x80. Register lane tests reject it. This is static arithmetic derivation, not enumeration, tests, emulation, SDK comparison or body execution.
zero_detection.read_schedule: Both actual DWORD reads are unconditional before the candidate branch. Preserve them even for mask0 and false candidates; no external stability assumption may erase the second read in Source.

prospective_Source_mechanism.byte_access: Separately sequenced volatile unsigned BYTE loads/stores over genuine raw storage with genuine cursor+1, preserving source advance before destination write. Avoid typed char signedness assumptions and all extra final rereads.
prospective_Source_mechanism.word_access: Proposed private target-specific MSVC Win32 addressed MOV32 raw load and addressed MOV32 raw store primitives. Load returns fully initialized uint32; store accepts uint32. The load must be called twice unconditionally at the same actual4aligned source address before source+4. Store must support the actual possibly unaligned destination. No invented live uint32 object, alignment for destination, memcpy, SDK/provider, fake context, fallback, global/TLS/table or runtime guard. A later Source gate must approve this mechanism and inspect every emitted public/private helper/inlined load/store and path.
prospective_Source_mechanism.state: Bounded unsigned32 counts/word counts and genuine BYTE cursors; fixed uint32 register arithmetic and masks, ordinary saved destination pointer. No array/aggregate, bitmap, table, switch, runtime helper or introduced GS-buffer mechanism is needed.
prospective_Source_mechanism.compiler_gate: No compilation performed here. Future strict Win32 object must independently prove widths/order, unconditional duplicate word loads, unaligned DWORD stores, exact BYTE padding and all helpers/calls/metadata/providers. Static/readiness evidence is not ABI/runtime/game proof.

register_ABI.count: Unsigned32, logical SHR2 and low2 remainder; no signed comparisons/cap. Positive word count always decremented from>=1; BYTE counts stop at0. Allbitpatterns have the stated genuine-storage/nonwrapping trace domain.
register_ABI.registers: Positive path saves/restores EDI/ESI/EBX; count0 saves/restores onlyEDI. EAX returns destination; ECX/EDX/EAX are local volatile state. No hidden register input, x87, no-return, tail-transfer, call or flow repair observed.
register_ABI.homes: Count home first, positive source home before destination home; final native destination-home reload. Home/private-frame/saved-register alias protocols excluded; new saved destination pointer is not Original home identity.
register_ABI.segments: All selected payload MOVs use ordinary default DS addressing, stack operations ordinary SS. No string/REP/ES operand, segment override, DF-sensitive opcode, CLD/STD, SSE/CPUID/dispatch, provider/global/TLS dependency or external branch. No exotic segment/physical fault/flag/register protocol claim.
